messages:
samir: Heads-up — post-metrics review: fragmentation + burst calls still causing tail errors. I think we need a two-part solution: smarter packing hints + a burst credit allocator that is fragmentation-aware.
clare: Agreed. Current credits ignore physical placement. If tenant needs contiguous MIG slices it fails even when raw GPU capacity exists.
jon: Idea: include a 'packing_preference' in tokens: contig | any | prefer-contig. Local allocator uses hint to try contiguous fit first, then fall back to any-fit if token allows.
esra: +1. Also we should surface a cheap bin-packing score to the operator so predictive prewarm avoids allocations likely to fragment. Score could be: contig_score = contiguous_free_slices / required_slices.
patti: For credit allocation, let's decouple baseline vs burst. Baseline = SLA allocation guaranteed. Burst credits are ephemeral and tied to recent steady usage. We should add a decay half-life so credits drop if tenant goes quiet.
clare: How long for half-life? 1 hour? 30 minutes? If too short, noisy spikes get penalized; too long, credits accumulate and hurt others.
jon: Let's prototype 45min half-life and require at least 3min sustained QPS to start earning. That seems like a good balance.
esra: Operator boundary question: who runs the compaction job that mitigates fragmentation? Operator should schedule occasional compaction when fragmentation > threshold, but that can be expensive. Maybe run compaction during low-util windows and only for high-value pools.
samir: Agree. Compaction = migrate some slices onto new nodes to free contiguous space. It's I/O and scheduling heavy. We should gate it by predicted benefit: if compaction_gain_estimate > cost_estimate * 2 then run.
patti: We need metrics: fragmentation_ratio, contig_block_count, compaction_gain_estimate, compaction_cost_estimate. Emit these per-pool.
clare: Token format sketch (compact, signed):
```
payload: t=acme;credits=4;pref=contig;exp=6820016000;h=5
enc: base64(payload).sig
```
where h is hint pack size (number of contiguous slices requested).
jon: Local admission agent logic: 1) verify sig & exp, 2) peek local allocator for contig fit if pref==contig, 3) if contig not possible and token allows fallback, try any-fit and mark 'fallback_used' tag, 4) decrement credits atomically and emit admit_{ok/deny} metric.
esra: Need atomic decrement across multi-threaded agents. Use a local memstore with compare-and-swap to avoid double spend. Also emit 'token_double_spend_attempt' if CAS fails repeatedly.
samir: For KMS/sig lifecycle: rotate signing keys hourly and issue short-lived tokens (ttl <= 1h). Operator exposes a signing endpoint with auth. That reduces blast radius from token leak.
clare: Observability: Console should show token issuance timeline, per-tenant credit balance, admit latency, fallback_rate, fragmentation_events and compaction runs. Also a per-pool dry-run toggle for simulating compaction.
patti: Billing: record prewarm_gpu_seconds and compaction_gpu_seconds separately. Tag whether prewarm was predictive or user-requested. Customers can opt-out of predictive prewarm for cost control.
jon: Edge case: two tenants with prefer-contig both vying for the same block. Admission agent should use a quick lease attempt window (100ms) and if fail, fallback to queued admission rather than immediate any-fit to avoid oscillation.
esra: Also add grace for preemption: when compaction/eviction occurs for prewarmed slices, give a 30s soft-grace for in-flight requests and decrement ephemeral credits by x for preempted requests. That disincentivizes aggressive prewarm hogging.
samir: Simulation plan: run Poisson burst sims with lambda spikes at 10x baseline, include mixed packing preferences, MIG sizes. Run 7-day traces and measure tail error rate and prewarm cost.
clare: I'll run sims and push results. Expect to iterate on half-life and compaction thresholds.
patti: Implementation action items:
- esra: design packing_preference token schema and signing flow.
- jon: prototype admission-agent changes, local CAS store, and fallback tagging.
- clare: run sims for 2 tenants (acme, zebra) and produce a tuning spreadsheet.
- samir: add console metrics + billing fields for prewarm/compaction.
- patti: draft opt-out and tenant config UI for predictive prewarm.
jon: quick log example from shim: 
```
[admit-shim] ts=6820012401 tenant=acme token_ok=true pref=contig fit=fail fallback_used=true credits_left=1 latency=21ms
```
esra: Also add a circuit-breaker: if compaction runs have failed >3 times in 12h or fragmentation_ratio keeps >0.35, disable predictive prewarm and surface alert to SRE.
samir: Good. Let's meet tomorrow 9am. orch-bot: can we get a staging canary for this?
orch-bot: deploy:pack-hint-admit branch queued for staging. PR #5130.
samir: Thanks team — capture notes and link PRs in the ticket.
